comment: Cursor rule emission map: runtime/rules/<file> -> .cursor/rules/counsel-<name>.mdc frontmatter. alwaysApply rules are ALSO delivered via the AGENTS.md sentinel block (Cursor reads AGENTS.md natively); .mdc emission is belt-and-suspenders for always-on and the only channel for future glob-scoped rules. Both are installer-generated from one source and manifest-tracked.
